subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Emergency preparation is not a sign that people expect disaster every day.”?
options: It is a quiet promise to act more calmly if one comes.
Nina said, "Being lost is scary, but staying quiet makes it worse."
A quiet room becomes better when everyone takes care of it.
When people have a quiet way to choose, the result may surprise you.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Emergency preparation is not a sign that people expect disaster every day. It is a quiet promise to act more calmly if…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Nina said, 'Being lost is scary, but staying quiet makes it worse.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A quiet room becomes better when everyone takes care of it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「When people have a quiet way to choose, the result may surprise you.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Emergency preparation is not a sign that people expect disaster every day. It is a quiet promise to act more calmly if one comes.」，答案為「It is a quiet promise to act more calmly if one comes.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It is a quiet promise to act more calmly if one comes.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
